g1|variants|standard sales order.summary: This family covers the standard Order-to-Cash sales order processing variants in SAP S/4HANA, ranging from standard cash sales and rush orders to quote-to-order conversions and standard orders with immediate delivery. The variants differ primarily by sales document types, billing relevance, schedule line categories, and subsequent logistics execution steps.

variants.name: Standard Order with Delivery and Billing
variants.when_used: Standard B2B sales process requiring an outbound delivery and billing document.
variants.key_config: Sales document type OR configured with delivery-related billing (F2) and schedule line category CP.

variants.name: Cash Sale with Immediate Delivery
variants.when_used: Counter sales where order, delivery, and invoice are generated simultaneously and paid immediately.
variants.key_config: Sales document type CS triggers immediate delivery creation upon saving and cash invoice (BV) generation.

variants.name: Rush Order with Subsequent Delivery
variants.when_used: Urgent customer orders where delivery is created immediately upon order entry and billing follows later.
variants.key_config: Sales document type RO automatically triggers outbound delivery creation in background upon order creation.

variants.name: Free-of-Charge Order (Sample/Replacement)
variants.when_used: Providing samples or replacement items to customers without generating a financial receivable.
variants.key_config: Item category TANN is configured as not billing-relevant, preventing invoice creation for zero-value items.

compare_groups.name: Sales Document Control
compare_groups.covers: Configuration governing sales document types, number ranges, and mandatory partner functions.

compare_groups.name: Item Category Determination
compare_groups.covers: Rules determining item categories based on sales document type and item category group.

compare_groups.name: Schedule Line Control
compare_groups.covers: Availability check settings, movement types, and transfer of requirements.

compare_groups.name: Delivery and Billing Integration
compare_groups.covers: Copy controls from sales order to outbound delivery and from delivery/order to billing.

g1|core|standard sales order|standard or.title: Standard Sales Order with Delivery and Billing
g1|core|standard sales order|standard or.story: Imagine a giant toy store where a customer points to a wooden train, pays for it, and the store packs it into a box and hands it over; in SAP, this flow moves goods from customer request to final invoice without a hitch. Technically, the process spans Order-to-Cash (OTC) execution starting from sales document type OR through delivery creation, warehouse picking, goods issue, and financial billing to document type F2.
g1|core|standard sales order|standard or.why_business_needs_it: This standard process ensures revenue recognition, inventory reduction, and customer satisfaction by executing end-to-end order fulfillment reliably. Without this core flow, companies cannot capture customer demand, fulfill shipments accurately, or generate legal invoices for accounting.

modules.role: Creates the sales order, checks availability, determines pricing, and creates outbound deliveries.
modules.hands_off_to: LE (Logistics Execution) for picking, packing, and goods issue processing.

modules.role: Manages shipping points, picking activities, and posts goods issue to update inventory.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) for billing and revenue posting.

modules.role: Generates customer invoices and posts open items to accounts receivable.

config_steps.step: Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: ZOR1; Dlv. type: LF; Iteml.increment: 10; Subtotal: 1; No.range int.assign: 01; No.range ext.assign: 02
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N on table TVAK and verify that ZOR1 exists with delivery type LF.
config_steps.why: This step tells SAP how to process your customer's order by setting rules for number assignment, delivery creation, and pricing.
config_steps.if_missing: If sales document type ZOR1 is missing, transaction VA01 will throw message V1002 "Sales document type ZOR1 does not exist".
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select standard sales document type OR and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Sales Doc. Type with ZOR1 and Description with "Standard Order OTC"
Set Dlv. type to LF, Dlv. block to blank, and Iteml.increment to 10
Set Subtotal to 1, No.range int.assign to 01, and No.range ext.assign to 02
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

run_steps.result: System creates Sales Order document (Type OR) with schedule lines and availability confirmation.
System generates Outbound Delivery document (Type LF) and reserves stock for picking.
System updates inventory, posts material movement via movement type 601, and updates delivery status.
System generates Billing Document (Type F2) and hands off posting data to Financial Accounting (FI-AR).

key_tables: VBEP -- Sales Document Schedule Line Data

errors.title: Shipping Point Determination Missing
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- saving the standard sales order
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot figure out which loading dock or warehouse ships the goods because a lookup rule is missing.
errors.cause: Shipping point determination failed in Sales Document Type OR because combination of Shipping Condition from customer master (KNB1-VBUND or KNVV-VSBED), Loading Group from material master (MARA-LADGR), and supplying plant (T001W-WERKS) has no entry in table TVSTZ.
errors.verify: Re-enter transaction VA01 for order type OR, enter item TAN with plant and verify the schedule line subscreen displays a valid shipping point without error.
errors.prevent: Ensure every new material master is created with a valid Loading Group and every customer master has a Shipping Condition assigned in the sales view.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Logistics Execution -> Shipping -> Basic Shipping Functions -> Shipping Point Determination -> Assign Shipping Points
fix_steps.values: Define rule: Shipping Condition + Loading Group + Plant -> Shipping Point

errors.title: Pricing Procedure Not Found
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- entering sales order pricing screen
errors.message_text: Pricing procedure could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know which pricing sheet to apply, so it cannot calculate the price for the customer.
errors.cause: Sales document pricing procedure determination is missing in table TVLK or T683V for the combination of Sales Area (Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Division), Customer Pricing Procedure (KNVV-KALKS), and Document Pricing Procedure (TVAK-KALSM).
errors.verify: Create a new sales order in VA01, go to item conditions tab, and confirm that condition types (e.g. PR00) populate automatically.
errors.prevent: Ensure that newly created customer or sales document types have corresponding entries mapped in the pricing procedure determination matrix.

fix_steps.step: Assign Pricing Procedure to Sales Area, Customer Pricing Procedure and Document Pricing Procedure
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define Pricing Procedure Determination
fix_steps.values: Sales Area + Customer Pricing Procedure (e.g. 1) + Document Pricing Procedure (A) -> Pricing Procedure (RVAA01)

errors.title: Item Category Not Determined
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- entering item number and material in sales order
errors.message_text: Item category &1 not allowed for sales document type &2
errors.plain_meaning: The system refuses to accept the material because it does not know how to process this specific item type inside this order type.
errors.cause: Item category determination is missing in table TIVSC or TVEPZ for the combination of Sales Document Type (TVAK-AUART = OR), Item Category Group from material master (MARA-MTLOS/MVGR1), Higher-Level Item Category, and Usage.
errors.verify: Enter item TAN in transaction VA01 with the relevant material and check that the item category populates correctly without errors.
errors.prevent: Verify item category group assignments whenever a new material type is introduced to ensure proper mapping to standard item category TAN.

fix_steps.step: Assign allowed item categories to sales document type and item category group
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Item -> Assign Item Categories
fix_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: OR + Item Category Group: BANS + Item Usage: [blank] + Default Item Category: TAN

errors.title: Schedule Line Category Missing
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- checking schedule lines in item details
errors.message_text: Schedule line category &1 not allowed for item category &2
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot schedule the delivery date for the item because the item and schedule line combination is unconfigured.
errors.cause: Schedule line category determination is missing in table T145F or TVEP for the combination of Item Category (TVAK-POSAR = TAN) and Requirements Type from Material Requirements Planning (MRP) classification.
errors.verify: Open schedule lines tab for item TAN in VA01 and verify schedule line category CP appears with confirmed quantities.
errors.prevent: Check material requirements planning parameters and ensure schedule line mapping is configured for all active item categories.

fix_steps.step: Assign schedule line category to item category and MRP type
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Schedule Lines -> Assign Schedule Line Categories
fix_steps.values: Item Category: TAN + MRP Group / Type -> Schedule Line Category: CP

errors.title: Billing Type Determination Missing for Billing Creation
errors.where_seen: VF01 -- creating billing document from delivery
errors.message_text: No billing document generated, check log
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot generate an invoice from the delivery because the connection rule between the sales/delivery document and the invoice type is broken.
errors.cause: Copy control configuration from Delivery Document Type (LIKP-LFART) to Billing Document Type (TVCPF) is missing, preventing the copy routine from pulling item data into billing type F2.
errors.config_step: Maintain Copy Control for Delivery to Billing Document
errors.verify: Execute transaction VF01 for the outbound delivery and confirm that billing document type F2 is successfully created.
errors.prevent: Ensure that copy controls are fully maintained across document chains (OR -> LF -> F2) during transport migrations.
errors.ref_title: Copy Control in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.step: Maintain copy control rules between delivery type and billing type F2
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Maintain Copy Control for Billing Documents -> Copy Control: Delivery to Billing Document
fix_steps.values: Source Delivery Type: LF + Target Billing Type: F2 -> Maintain item level copy routine (e.g., routine 051)

errors.title: Credit Check Block Active
errors.plain_meaning: The order is placed on hold because the customer owes too much money or has exceeded their financial credit limit.
errors.cause: Automatic credit check in SAP Credit Management (FSCM) or SD classic credit management determined that exposure exceeds the credit limit for credit control area, causing credit status to set delivery block.
errors.verify: Re-check sales order status in VA03 and verify that the delivery block due to credit has been removed.
errors.prevent: Monitor customer account balances regularly and maintain appropriate credit limits in business partner master data.

fix_steps.step: Release credit block via credit management workspace or transaction
fix_steps.values: Select sales order, release credit block status, or adjust credit limit in UKM_BP

g1|core|standard sales order|cash sale w.title: Cash Sale with Immediate Delivery (Order-to-Cash)
g1|core|standard sales order|cash sale w.story: Imagine walking up to a store register, paying for an item, and walking right out with it in your hand. In SAP, a Cash Sale automatically generates the sales order, the outbound delivery, and the billing document in the background all at once when saved. This setup enables immediate counter sales where payment and physical goods handover occur simultaneously before standard credit terms apply.
g1|core|standard sales order|cash sale w.why_business_needs_it: Retail counters, walk-in showrooms, and on-site spare parts counters require immediate processing without waiting for delayed billing runs or manual delivery creation. Automating immediate billing and delivery generation accelerates cash collection and keeps inventory accounting synchronized in real-time.

modules.role: Controls sales document type CS, item category TAN, schedule line category CN, immediate delivery creation on save, and cash billing type BV.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) via billing document transfer and MM (Materials Management) for goods issue posting.

modules.role: Manages outbound delivery creation triggered instantly by the sales order and executes goods issue posting.
modules.hands_off_to: MM (Materials Management) for updating inventory stock levels and FI-GL (General Ledger) for COGS posting.

modules.role: Posts cash sales revenue directly against a cash clearing account and handles immediate payment settlement.

prerequisites: Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Division assigned to Sales Area via OVXG
Plant assigned to Sales Organization and Distribution Channel via OVX3
Shipping Point determination configured via OVL2
Customer Master Data created with appropriate Cash Customer Reconciliation Account via XD01 or BP
Material Master Data created with sales and plant views via MM01

config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Copying Control Sales Document -> Delivery Document": Overview

actions: Enter /nVTFL in the command field and press Enter
Select source delivery document LF and target billing document BV, then click Details
Set Copying requirements to 003
Double-click Item in the dialog structure
Select item category TAN and set Item copying requirements to 001

errors.plain_meaning: The system forgot to pack the box right away when the cash order was saved.
errors.cause: The shipping point determination failed or the sales document type CS is not configured for immediate delivery creation in transaction VOV8.

g1|core|standard sales order|rush order.title: Rush Order with Subsequent Delivery (Order-to-Cash)
g1|core|standard sales order|rush order.story: A rush order is a special sale where the customer wants the goods extremely fast, and the delivery is created automatically right after you save the order. In the SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC) process, this means sales document type RO generates an immediate outbound delivery, which is then picked, packed, and shipped before billing with type F2. When the order is saved, the system immediately triggers the delivery creation routine in the background, allowing warehouse operations to process the shipment without manual delivery creation steps.
g1|core|standard sales order|rush order.why_business_needs_it: This process supports high-priority customers who need same-day order processing and fulfillment while maintaining full financial and inventory control in the ERP. It bypasses the routine manual delivery creation step, reducing order-to-delivery lead time significantly.

modules.role: Manages customer master data, sales order entry for type RO, pricing, and automatic immediate delivery triggering.
modules.hands_off_to: LE-SHP to generate the outbound delivery document and manage shipping execution.

prerequisites: Customer master record with sales area data created -- XD01 / BP
Material master record with sales and plant data created -- MM01

config_steps.step: Define Sales Document Type RO for Rush Order
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: RO; Order category: C; Checking group: 02; Dlv. related blg type: F2; Shipping condition: 01; Immediate delivery: X
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N for table TVAK and verify entry RO exists with immediate delivery indicator X.
config_steps.why: A rush order requires automatic delivery creation upon save to accelerate warehouse processing.
config_steps.if_missing: If missing, saving sales document type RO causes message V1313 indicating the sales document type is not defined, stopping order entry.
actions: Enter transaction /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select sales document type OR and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Sales Doc. Type with RO and Description with Rush Order
Set Order category to C in the General Control section
Set Dlv. related blg type to F2 and check the Immediate delivery indicator (X) in the Shipping section
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Target rush order document type key
Descriptive text for the document type

Default shipping condition for rush orders

config_steps.where: OVLK -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types for Rush Orders
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Assign Delivery Types / Shipping Points": Details
config_steps.values: Sales Area: 1000/10/00; Sales Document Type: RO; Delivery Type: LF; Shipping Point: 1000
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N on table TVLKZ to confirm table entry linking RO and LF for sales organization 1000.
config_steps.why: The system must know which outbound delivery type to generate when a rush order is saved.
config_steps.if_missing: If unconfigured, saving a rush order results in message VL381 where the system cannot determine a delivery type, failing automated delivery creation.
actions: Enter transaction /nOVLK in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries in the application toolbar
Enter Sales Org. 1000, Dlv. Type LF, and Sales Doc. Type RO
Enter Shipping Point 1000 and Shipping Cond. 01
Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm transport request

Select standard item category TAN and click Copy As (F6)
Change Item Category to TAN and Description to Standard item (Rush)
Ensure Item type is Standard, Pricing is set to X, and Billing relevance is set to B

config_steps.if_missing: Entering a material with group NORM on order type RO results in message V1320 (Item category not determined), halting order creation.

Click New Entries
Enter Sales Doc. Type RO, Item Category Group NORM, and leave Higher Level Item blank
Enter Default Item Ca. as TAN
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport

config_steps.if_missing: Without delivery relevance, saving the rush order does not trigger the outbound delivery creation routine.
actions: Enter transaction /nVOV6 in the command field and press Enter
Select schedule line category CP and click Copy As (F6)
Change Schedule line cat to CP and Description to Rush order schedule line
Set Order category to C, Item category to A for availability check, and set Delivery relevance to X
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport

config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: RO; Item Category: TAN; Material Checking Group: 02; Default Schedule Line Category: CP
config_steps.check: Create an item with TAN on order RO and verify schedule line category CP populates on the schedule lines tab.
config_steps.why: Ensures inventory availability checks are executed and delivery documents are correctly requested.
config_steps.if_missing: If unconfigured, order items lack schedule lines, displaying message V1323 (Schedule line category not determined).
actions: Enter transaction /nVOV5 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Doc. Type RO, Item Category TAN, and Material Checking Group 02
Enter Default sched. line cat as CP
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport

config_steps.step: Define Shipping Point Determination
config_steps.where: OVL2 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Shipping > Basic Shipping Functions > Shipping Point and Goods Receipt Determination > Assign Shipping Points
config_steps.values: Shipping Condition: 01; Loading Group: 0001; Plant: 1000; Assigned Shipping Point: 1000
config_steps.check: Simulate shipping point determination by creating an order with plant 1000 and loading group 0001.
config_steps.why: Shipping point determination is required for outbound delivery creation to successfully execute warehouse hand-off.
config_steps.if_missing: If missing, saving a rush order generates message VL392 (Shipping point cannot be determined), blocking automatic delivery generation.
actions: Enter transaction /nOVL2 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Shipping Condition 01, Loading Group 0001, and Plant 1000
Enter Assigned Shipping Point 1000
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport

config_steps.step: Create Customer Master Data for Rush Orders
config_steps.where: BP -- SAP Menu > Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Business Partner > Maintain Business Partner
config_steps.values: BP Role: Customer; Sales Area: 1000/10/00; Shipping Condition: 01; Delivering Plant: 1000
config_steps.check: Run transaction XD03 or BP to verify sales area data and shipping conditions are correctly saved.
config_steps.why: Customer master shipping parameters drive the delivery creation logic and plant assignment in rush orders.
config_steps.if_missing: Without shipping condition 01 in the customer master, shipping point determination fails and blocks delivery creation.
actions: Enter transaction /nBP in the command field and press Enter
Click Organization and select grouping to create a new customer business partner
Fill in general address data and assign BP Role Customer (FI Customer / SD Customer)
Switch to Sales and Distribution view, enter Sales Area 1000 / 10 / 00
Navigate to Shipping tab and set Shipping Condition to 01 and Delivering Plant to 1000
Save (Ctrl+S) and note the generated Business Partner number

config_steps.step: Create Material Master Data for Rush Orders
config_steps.where: MM01 -- SAP Menu > Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > MM01 - Create
config_steps.values: Material: High-demand FG; Industry sector: M; Material type: HALB; Views: Sales: General/Plant, Sales Org. 1, Sales Org. 2
config_steps.check: Run transaction MM03 for material High-demand FG and verify loading group 0001 is set on the plant view.
config_steps.why: Material master loading group and sales views are required to determine shipping points and item categories.
config_steps.if_missing: If missing, item category and shipping point determination fail, preventing order and delivery creation.
actions: Enter transaction /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Material as High-demand FG, Industry sector M, and Material type HALB
Click Select Views and select Sales: General/Plant, Sales Org. 1, and Sales Org. 2
Enter Organizational Levels Plant 1000, Sales Org 1000, and Dist. Channel 10
Enter Loading Group 0001 on Sales: General/Plant tab and default tax classification
Save (Ctrl+S) to create the material master record
